title: Microprecision Orchestrator for latency-critical prefetch and decode lanes
creator: Sofia Ramirez
description:
Goal: Implement a lightweight 'Microprecision Orchestrator' (MPO) that dynamically assigns a small per-request precision budget and schedules prefetch/decode lanes to reduce P95 decode latency for latency-sensitive inference while bounding per-token cost and avoiding quality regressions.

Background: Current runtime picks kernels primarily based on static heuristics (per-layer profile + batch size). For mixed-precision workloads (INT8/FP8 fallback), dequantization overhead and precision handoffs during prefill/streaming decode cause tail latency spikes for small interactive requests. We need a control plane that coordinates kernel selection, prefetch windows, and staged quant->dequant transitions at token granularity without a heavy runtime penalty.

Scope: MPO runtime module + scheduling policy + perf tests. MVP will cover single-GPU and multi-GPU streaming decode paths, KV cache warm reads, and the most common model family (decoder-only transformer 30B). The operator will: (1) compute a per-request precision budget based on SLO/tier, (2) select a sequence of kernel variants for prefill and decode respecting budget, (3) schedule micro-prefetches of KV shards and selective dequantization to amortize cost, (4) expose telemetry for per-token cost/latency/quality trade-offs.
progress_updates: 2025-02-12: RFC created and reviewed by runtime lead. Outlined MPO concept and initial policy primitives.
2025-02-18: Prototype token-credit scheduler implemented in branch runtime/microprecision-credit. Basic per-request budget propagation works end-to-end for synthetic RNG input.

2025-02-22: Integration test with continuous batching harness shows 12% P95 tail reduction for microbatch size=1 when using INT8 fastpath for head layers and selective FP8 for final projection. Noted a small BLEU-like metric drift (0.7%) on prompt set 'chatty-small' — flagged for Evals run.
2025-02-26: Design review with PM and Design. Agreed to add a conservative 'safety' policy that forces FP8 for final decode step if eval regression > 0.5%.
2025-03-01: Implemented telemetry counters for per-token dequant time and kernel-switch count. Preparing perf dashboard and larger eval runs (1000 prompts).
decisions: Use a lightweight credit-based budget per request (integer tokens) instead of continuous probability thresholds to keep scheduling O(1) per-token.
Prefer INT8 microkernels for attention matmuls on early layers with fallbacks to FP8 for later layers based on headwise quality sensitivity profile.
Defer full zero-copy dequant optimization to follow-up; MVP will use selective staged dequant (only active heads and top-K heads) to reduce immediate implementation risk.
Expose a developer-facing API flag 'precision_hint' to allow product teams to opt into aggressive budget modes for premium customers.
Safety fallback: if per-prompt eval score drops by >0.5% or decoding diverges significantly, MPO will auto-escalate to conservative precision profile for the rollout window.
Telemetry will be emitted per-request: tokens_used, kernel_switches, dequant_ms, p99_latency_ms, quality_delta.
acceptance_criteria: P95 decode latency reduced by >=10% for interactive microbatches (size=1) on target model under realistic traffic mix on dedicated GPU pool.
Per-token cost increase <=3% compared to baseline (no MPO) or net cost reduction for typical chat workloads when batching effects are counted.
No more than 0.5% regression on primary eval suite (chatty-small + instruction-qa).
Feature flag gated rollout implemented and end-to-end integration tests in CI passing for single-GPU and 2-GPU shards.
Perf dashboard charts for per-token dequant time, kernel selection distribution, and quality delta are available and linked in the ticket.
test_plan: Unit tests for credit arithmetic and budget propagation (edge cases: 0-credit, negative-credit prevention).
Microbench harness: run end-to-end decode for 1k prompts with and without MPO, collect P50/P95/P99 and per-token dequant time.
Evals: run both 'chatty-small' and 'instruction-qa' suites and compare BLEU-like/QA accuracy metrics; rollback threshold set at 0.5% for regressions.
Long-run soak test under continuous batching to ensure MPO does not starve throughput-critical lanes (48-hour run).
Load test: simulate mixed-precision heavy pattern with bursts and verify safety fallback triggers and stability.
comments: Kenji: 'Initial microbench numbers look promising; need to validate across A100 and H100 kernels — differences in dequant memcpy cost could flip the decision.'
Priya (PM): 'Important to provide a clear opt-out for enterprise customers until KMS/audit logs are validated for Private deployments.'
Design: 'UX should surface precision_hint and per-route SLO mapping; placeholder in console accepted for MVP.'
SRE: 'Ensure MPO does not increase OOM risk by prefetching too aggressively; add circuit breaker to back off prefetch window.'
